update.name: CVE-2026-135722
update.description: FFmpeg <9.1: wavenc peak_init_writer() accepts zero channels, sizing the peak buffer to zero — wav_write_packet overflows the heap. Verbatim guard from 0b1c279^ vs fix with ASan: heap WRITE overflow on vuln, ERANGE on fixed

update.name: CVE-2026-135706
update.description: FFmpeg <9.1: modplug_read_header() allocates max_size instead of sz — a crafted module with max_size=0 overflows the 0-byte buffer via avio_read. Verbatim allocation from edc96a2^ vs av_malloc(sz) with ASan: heap WRITE overflow on vuln, clean on fixed

update.name: CVE-2026-135725
update.description: FFmpeg <9.1: ff_rtmp_packet_write() uses a 16-byte stack buffer for an 18-byte RTMP header — extended timestamp packets overflow the stack. Verbatim buffer size from 041098a^ vs fix with ASan: stack WRITE overflow on vuln, clean on fixed
